title: רב עוקבא בר חמא ואחיו רמי שניהם חתני דרב חסדא

paragraphs: Rav Ukva bar Ḥama and his brother Rami were both Rav Ḥisda's sons-in-law, Berakhot 44a. Mar Ukva bar Ḥama, Arakhin 25a. He cited R. Yose bar Ḥanina, Zevaḥim 55b. In one version, he objected to Rav Naḥman, Bava Metzia, Eizehu Neshekh 65a. Rami came before Rav Sheshet, and Mar Ukva before Rav Naḥman, Ketubbot 94b.
